violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing hose on the sanitizer dispensing system at the 3-compartment is broken and leaks when turned on.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. repair our replace the leaking hose.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Chick chicken-less=60F, turkey=59F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Both food items were replaced.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The serving table that is being used on Serving Line 4, to hold cold salad items and sandwiches was not designed for hold cold foods. This table is not capable of holding cold potentially hazardous food at 41F. It is designed for holding hot foods. Do not use this equipment for cold foods. Provide the appropriate equipment that is intended for holding cold foods. This table is constantly giving off heat when in use.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. This was previously cited, correct permanently.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:roasted corn=47F, chicken-less = 49F, turkey=54F, spicy chicken=48F, shredded cheese=54F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Use adequate ice-water bath to hold foods intended top be served cold, for proper cold holding. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the empoyees restroom doors are not self closing.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Install self-closings devises on the restroom doors, especially if the locker rooms doors are left opened.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: A variety of sauces in squeeze bottles.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Labeled during the inspection.
